question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a orange present, Bob has a silver present, and Claire has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) orange present
(B) silver present
(C) purple present
solution:
Present colors in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: orange | silver | purple
1. Bob swaps with Alice: silver | orange | purple
2. Bob swaps with Alice again: orange | silver | purple
3. Alice swaps with Claire: purple | silver | orange
Bob has the silver present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
